de: - 2026 exposure: campaigns with DSA, auto-created assets, or campaign-level broad match auto-upgrade to AI Max from September 2026; diagnosis of those campaigns names the upgrade as a moving part before recommending long structural work.
para: - 2026–2027 exposure: campaigns with auto-created assets or campaign-level broad match auto-upgraded to AI Max from September 2026; Dynamic Search Ads (DSA) campaigns migrate later, in February 2027 (Google postponed the DSA date). Diagnosis of those campaigns names the upgrade as a moving part before recommending long structural work; for DSA, plan the migration before February 2027 instead of treating it as already done.
porque: Google adiou a migração do DSA para AI Max para fevereiro de 2027 (ACA e ampla de campanha migraram em setembro de 2026)
